reviews.title: Great choice from a reputable brand
reviews.comment: The power supply came in great condition and was exactly what i needed to revive an older I7-9700k Build.  The power supply's cables were long enough to reach all the correct connections from the motherboard and the PCIE 16 pin was easy to snap into place on the GTX 1080 video card I was using.  The power range was good and didn't have any notable instability while running intensive games like Resident Evil 2 Remake or Destiny 2.  The PCIE 5.0 compatibility is a great addition for future proofing if I decide to upgrade to a 4000 or 5000 series card in the future.  The 16 pin configuration helps with ease of use when connecting the power adapter to the already complicated looking port.  I some times have issues with having to line up two 8+8 pin connectors for video cards due to heatsink clearance but, this wasn't the case this time.  The design on the power supply shroud was tasteful with it's dark grey markings and it won't stand out too much to match my build.  Overall a good choice for the price point.

reviews.title: Lots of cable connection and it is ATX 3.1 ready
reviews.comment: Compared to other 750 Bronze in its class, this one has native 12V-2x6 Connector and ATX 3.1 ready. So it is future proof. The box also has so many cable connections that you can upgrade hard drives, graphics card and SSD. Once I put this in my system, i realize that it is also quite and doesn't make that much noise. So overall , I am happy with my purchase and recommend for people that is building budget systems.
